title: Defeated Filo Rial
paragraphs: “Do you know her, Éclair?”
“Sorry, I can’t quite remember. I feel like I might have met her somewhere before, though.”
Well, Éclair is knowledgeable about demi-humans and beastmen.
Maybe she’s had that kind of experience before?
“By the way, from what I’ve talked with her, she’s someone who’s strangely easy to talk to. I guess you could say she’s a good conversationalist?”
“Despite that, you were being quite cautious. That’s not like Naofumi.”
“Uh… it’s just that the fact she was using a fake name reminded me of that princess, and it made me a little uneasy. I’ll handle it properly next time.”
“I see. I thought you’d already gotten over it, but after being betrayed like that, it’s not something you can overcome easily…”
Ren said that with concern, and Father and the others all turned their gazes toward me.
They’re all curious about the older sister of that older sister, huh?
“So, what kind of person is she?”

“She’s the older sister of that older sister. In the village, she was mostly in her beastman form and acted as a parent figure to the slaves. She was another advisor, separate from Father, and everyone relied on her. Her abilities and actions are truly admirable.”

Even the Filolial-sama trusted her and would visit her whenever there was trouble. I’m not sure how close she was with Father, but I do remember that they often consulted with each other. And besides, she’s the older sister of that older sister, even if only by association. She’s someone worthy of respect in many ways.
“A person that Motoyasu speaks so highly of, and someone who has child-rearing abilities on par with Naofumi… She’d definitely be valuable. As a caretaker.”
“What kind of logic is that!?”
“…Considering how those Filolials are managed. It’s too much for Naofumi alone.”
“Ren, it’s the same for Éclair too, but instead of dumping everything on me, shouldn’t you and Itsuki help take care of everyone?”
Father said that with an exasperated tone. He’s absolutely right. If Ren and Itsuki could ease Father’s burden, the world would be a much better place.
“Also, she seems to be knowledgeable about magic and has mastered dragon vein techniques. During battles, she was in charge of ritual and chant magic while leading everyone.”
“She sounds quite capable. If she’s trustworthy, we should definitely bring her into the group.”
“Well, yeah… If she knows her way around Zeltoble, it’s worth relying on her.”
“Hmm. For now, I suppose Iwatani-dono should take a nap until the afternoon?”
“Yeah, I think I’ll do that. After that, I’ll take Imia-chan and Sakura-chan to meet Sadina.”
“Gaelion wants to go too!”
The rival, who had been silent until now, suddenly voiced his desire.
By the way, where’s the assistant? Is he still sleeping?
“That’s for the best. I’ll also work with Amaki-dono to come up with as many strategies as possible. We need to find Imia-dono’s relatives.”
“What should I do?”
“Hmm… Motoyasu-kun, well…”
Oh? Father’s response seems a bit hesitant.
“If you could just take care of Yuki-chan’s condition. She’s going to be in the Filolial race, after all.”
“Understood. I shall listen carefully to the producers and memorize everything, I shall.”
I should also remember the complicated theories I’ve discussed with the head veterinarian. Meeting Filo-tan is my ultimate goal, but I also want to learn more and more about the Filolial-sama.
“We’ll be looking for people, but should we also watch the colosseum matches?”
“That’s a good idea. I’ve heard that in Zeltoble, earning trust through the colosseum is an effective method. With Amaki-dono’s skill, making a name for himself should be easy.”
“Well, he is a Hero… Either way, we should talk to the people of the country about it.”
“I’m counting on you. Alright then… later.”
Father, looking extremely sleepy, sluggishly walked away and immediately fell asleep in the room’s bed.

“Itsuki will probably be looking for companions, Naofumi will be recruiting that panda, Motoyasu is handling the Filolial-related inspections, and Éclair and I will meet with the people of the country and watch the colosseum… It’s going to be a busy time.”
“Indeed.”
“Motoyasu, you’re really good at taking things easy. If you were better at explaining things, none of this would have happened.”

Ren was complaining about something, but I had already started my studies related to the Filolial race, which was my task for the day. That day, I asked Yuki-chan and the Filolial producers many things.
“Huh? What’s up?”
“Have the procedures been completed?”
“Haven’t you heard from the Shield Hero?”
“I didn’t hear anything about it yesterday.”
“Oh, that’s right. You weren’t around, were you? So, what’s this about?”
“I am deeply interested in the Filolial race, I am.”
I leaned in close to the producer as I asked. The producer looked troubled and took two or three steps back.
“R-right. So, what do you want to know?”
“From one to ten, I want to learn everything there is to know about Filolial-sama.”

There are various types of Filolial races—some with jockeys, some without, obstacle races, grass tracks, dirt tracks, and many more. At best, I only know about the breeds and characteristics of the Filolial-sama. I realized I must learn everything necessary.
“Well, I don’t know if there’s anything more to teach beyond your enthusiasm…”
“By the way, you’re studying the changes in the Filolial-sama raised by the Hero, aren’t you?”
“Yeah, together with the researcher the Shield Hero brought. That guy’s brilliant. She has perspectives and ideas that I don’t.”
The producer looked satisfied. She seemed to be in a good mood. It seems he likes the head veterinarian. Well, considering he’s Filo-tan’s personal doctor, that’s only natural.
“Just thinking about that Yuki entering the championship race gets me excited.”
“I’ll do my best! But from what I saw yesterday, it seemed a bit slow, didn’t it?”
“That’s fine. At first, it’ll probably feel so easy that it’ll be boring.”

The producer began to talk about a vision of the future. Apparently, thanks to the Hero’s upbringing, it’s going to be a revolutionary event that will completely change the Filolial-sama raised so far. The Filolial-sama raised by the Hero will bring about a turning point in the long history of the Filolial races. Eventually, Filolial breeders will entrust the best Filolial-sama they’ve produced to the Heroes for further training. If that happens, Yuki-chan, who will be renowned as the first, will be chased by a variety of swift Filolial-sama from behind, all trying to catch up and surpass her.
“I see… So, they all feel slow at first.”
“For the first year or so, every race she enters will probably feel like a breeze.”
“But after that, the real competition begins, doesn’t it?”
“Yeah, that’s when things get serious. The ones who’ll be chasing her… are the Filolial raised by the Heroes, including your foster parent.”
Yuki-chan’s hands were trembling with excitement. She’s looking forward to it.
“Winning awards is important too. Yuki will… do her best to leave her name in the history of the Filolial world!”
“I understand the producer’s ambitions, I do.”
I’ve been managing the Filolial-sama as well, but it seems I need to learn more about how to make them run faster. Moreover, running in a race is completely different from pulling a carriage.
“Then, well… Normally, there’d be a lot of training involved, but… since this Filolial was raised one-on-one by a Hero, I doubt there’ll be any issues. Still, do you want to go through it?”
“I’ll do it!”
“I’ll do it, I will!”
“Alright then, I’ll teach you. Spear Hero, you’re so devoted to Filolial that this might be hard for you to accept, but… there’s something called the ‘losing Filolial’—”

The Filolial producer explained the dark side of the Filolial races. It’s about Filolial-sama who are forced to lose to create winners, and those whose legs get injured and are euthanized. They’re Filolial-sama raised with the purpose of losing from the start. Winners gain confidence and develop a hunger for victory. To be honest, it was something that could drive me insane, but… this too is part of the Filolial-sama’s history. Just as being good at singing and dancing makes one attractive to the opposite sex, in this world, being fast is the only thing that gives them value.
“This is all very educational, it is. There are some terrible truths, aren’t there?”

Come to think of it, Yuki-chan and the others often played racing games. Yuki-chan usually wins, but Kou and Sakura-chan… in this case, would be considered the ‘losing Filolial-sama.’ Chapter 718 – Moles I learned a lot about condition checks as well. I was guided to the training Filolial stables and the resting Filolial stables. I learned about the condition of Filolial-sama’s legs and other related knowledge.
“Well, in your case, there’s probably no need to worry about leg problems.”
“Yuki is sturdy.”
“I know.”
“However… I can tell just by looking, there are people who are dedicating themselves entirely to this.”

I wonder how the Filolial-sama preparing for the Filolial races looked through Yuki-chan’s eyes. For some reason, it reminded me of professional boxers. It brought back memories of watching a match with a pig who was a boxing fan. Their bodies were stripped to the bare minimum… appearing as nothing but skin and bones, yet it was a fierce and intense match. I remember feeling the raw intensity of it when watching it live.

Surely… the Filolial races will be a display of such artistic offense and defense. Everything is merely preparation to overcome that race. I understood that denying that fact wouldn’t get me anywhere. I won’t deny that the law of the jungle exists. It even exists among Filolial-sama. The effort to go one step further… I was deeply impressed. Yuki-chan will probably carve a new path in that history. This Motoyasu is thrilled about Yuki-chan’s future success.
“There might even be a Filolial Queen & King Cup held someday. It would be the ultimate festival for Filolial.”
“Whoa!”
“The Heroes are researching the most effective diets for Filolial. I’ll pour all my resources into the Filolial as well!”

The producer was truly a fanatic when it came to Filolial. By the way, I was later taught that the losing Filolial are used for combat. Being sturdy is prioritized in that case. Apparently, being slow isn’t a major handicap in battle. When it comes to Filolial-sama, I can’t help but aim for the best… I can’t afford to lose.
“Well, after a while, there’s also going to be a Filolial Battle tournament. I’ll need your help when that time comes.”
“Understood!”
Father muttered something about cockfighting. It seems there’s a competition where Filolial-sama, wearing ceremonial belts, engage in sumo matches. That sounds like an exciting event.
“Do Filolial races just go around a dome?”
“Hmm? Well… there are also grand races that go from town to town, even crossing countries. That’s called a Filolial Rally. Endurance is key in those races.”
“Oh…”
“You really want to try everything, don’t you? But before that, you have a lot to learn about Filolial, don’t you?”
“Indeed!”

Ah, while I do want to see Filo-tan, my desire to learn more and more about Filolial-sama is consuming my heart and won’t let go! Just like that, I spent the whole day studying about Filolial-sama. I thought it was still morning, but before I realized it, it was already night. Well, more like evening. I stopped reading through the materials at the Filolial-related facilities and returned to the place where I was staying. When I arrived, I found that Father and the others, including Ren, had already gathered.
“Ah, welcome back, Motoyasu-kun and Yuki-chan.”
“We have returned!”
Oh? There are lots of moles here. The mole who first became one of Father’s subordinates looks quite pleased.
“Have you found the relatives of the mole?”
“Yeah! Sadina-san guided us to a well-known slave trader in Zeltoble. We spent quite a bit of time on treatment and such, but we finally found them!”
“Th-Thank you so much…”
The mole is expressing gratitude to the big sister. Hmm, as expected of the big sister. To have found the mole’s relatives after such a difficult search… quite impressive.
“I’m glad I could help. Naofumi-chan, you really are the Shield Hero.”
The big sister responded kindly.
“So, Naofumi-chan, you’re going to have a reunion celebration now, right? Can I join in too?”
“Yeah. I want to celebrate Imia-chan finally being reunited with her relatives, and I also want to thank Sadina-san.”
“Thank you so much for taking care of Imia.”
Oh? I believe that’s the mole who does smithing. I remember having them make a lot of claws for Filolial-sama. Come to think of it, they were Imia’s uncle.
“Truly… I was worried about what had happened to my brother and sister-in-law… but at least I’m relieved that my niece Imia is safe. And to think she was saved by the Hero…”
“It was just by chance that I ran into her. I wish I could have helped her a bit sooner…”
Father answered the moles apologetically. But the moles shook their heads in unison.
“No, no, just being freed from slavery is more than enough. It would be selfish to ask for anything more. Please, Hero-sama, do not concern yourself.”
“If that’s how you feel… So, what will everyone do from here on? If you’d like, I can negotiate with the country and various places to arrange a place for you to live.”

The moles seem to be discussing among themselves in response to Father’s question. It’s true that deciding what to do from now on is important. As Father said, providing them with a place to live would be a good idea. It wouldn’t be bad for Father to manage some territory, like in the first world.
“With our numbers so few now… should we rebuild the village… or maybe start some kind of business somewhere…”
“Um…”
The mole took Father’s hand and seemed to propose something to the blacksmith mole.
“I… um… I would like to stay by the Hero’s side as a companion.”
“That’s right. But, as I said before, Imia-chan, I want to prepare a place where you can return and feel safe.”
The blacksmith mole looked back and forth between the mole and Father and, seeming to understand something, nodded repeatedly.
“Hero-sama, I know it’s an unreasonable request, and I apologize for the imposition… but we also want to be of help to you. Please, teach us many things.”
The other moles all nodded along with the blacksmith mole’s words. A commendable attitude indeed.
“Hmm… should I secure a village or maybe a facility where the Hero can train companions, like Motoyasu-kun mentioned before…?”
Father responded, looking slightly troubled. That’s right. Entrusting their future to Father is the natural course of things. Everyone relies on Father.
“And please, continue to look after Imia from now on as well.”
“Of course. But there’s something I want everyone to remember.”
“What would that be?”
Father turned to the moles with a slightly stern expression.

“Just because the Hero is protecting you, don’t think that makes you special. And don’t think that relying on the Hero will solve everything. If you ever start thinking like that and act on it, we’ll stop helping immediately.”
Oh? This reminds me of something Father said in the first world. The phrasing was different, but Father said something along these lines back then.
“It’s not just the Heroes summoned from another world who protect this world. I want to work with those who genuinely want to save this world together.”
Upon hearing Father’s words, the moles applauded. Yes, yes, a natural reaction.
Now go ahead and praise Father to the fullest!
“Imia-chan, you understand too, right?”
“Umm… yes. Everyone… just because the Hero helps us doesn’t mean we can be selfish… That would make us no better than the bad people.”
The other moles seemed to agree with the mole’s words.
“For now, I think everyone should return home once… and think about the future from there. If possible, I believe rebuilding that land would be best.”
“But… Melromarc is…”

“The Three Heroes Church of Melromarc has been deemed a heretical cult and was converted to the Four Saints Faith. Eclair-san here is the daughter of the lord of the Seatto region, and her lost authority has been restored. You can safely return to your village without worry.”
